verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language with "no dashboard navigation required". It also exposes action tools such as Create-Dashboard, and the homepage pitches AI agents and AI replay summaries. The natural-language path runs mainly through an external AI assistant connected over MCP. Missing for 10: documented native in-app natural-language command interface, evidence of natural-language control beyond querying and dashboard creation (e.g., configuring cohorts, flags or settings), independent or hands-on corroboration.
